full_text:
Article 6 (Composition, etc. of Special Committees)
(1) A special committee established under Article 8 (2) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "special committee") shall consist of no more than 15 members, including its chairperson (hereinafter referred to as a "special committee chairperson").
(2) A special committee chairperson shall be designated by the chairperson of the Committee from among Committee members, or commissioned by the chairperson from among experts in fields related to agriculture, fisheries, and rural communities.
(3) Members of a special committee shall be commissioned by the chairperson, after hearing the special committee chairperson's opinion, from among experts with extensive knowledge and experience concerning specific pending issues related to agriculture, fisheries, and rural communities.
(4) The existence of a special committee shall be limited to a maximum of one year: Provided, That where necessary, the period may be extended once only, by no more than one year, following a resolution of the Committee.
